runner.semantics: Checks the 307 pinned official VP9 vectors against their decoded-output MD5 ledgers; it does not invoke vpxdec.

dispatch_observation.actual_dispatch: Native AArch64 dispatch; this did not exercise scalar-only routing.
dispatch_observation.source_basis: In crates/rvp9-core/src/dsp/caps.rs, force_scalar_env is cfg-gated to x86_64 (lines 85-92); AArch64Caps::detect reads the native NEON and dotprod feature predicates (lines 109-123).

runs.command: deltic timeout 1800 env RVP9_FORCE_SCALAR=1 target/release/conformance --vectors-dir tests/conformance/vectors --official --strict --threads 1
deltic timeout 1800 env RVP9_FORCE_SCALAR=1 target/release/conformance --vectors-dir tests/conformance/vectors --official --strict --threads 2

limits: These exact-revision runs add current macOS native-dispatch conformance evidence; they do not meet the Mac scalar-dispatch gate.
The result reproduces the dispatch limitation tracked by RVP9-BUG-FLU-00043; the bug remains Open.
These conformance results do not establish external-decoder parity, production corpus coverage, compression quality, throughput, or frame latency.
